text: Undergraduate Advising UndergraduateAdvising Undergraduate Office Location: JO 2.110 Phone: 972-883-2428 Email: bbsadvising@utdallas.edu Office Hours: Mondays-Fridays. 8:30 am – 4 pm Wednesdays closed between 12:30 pm – 2 pm Drop-in Advising. BBS Advising is open for drop-in meetings Monday–Friday, 8:30 am – 4 pm. We are closed Wednesdays 12:30pm – 2 pm for staff meeting. Drop-in meetings are limited to 10 minutes. If you require a more in-depth meeting, please schedule an appointment. We are also available for advising via email. Please email bbsadvising@utdallas.edu with any advising questions.
